founder_role: Founder and Managing Director, LSV Industry Co., Ltd.
founder_p1: Nut Samphois grew LSV Industry from a family business into a Cambodian maker of household and personal care products. Drawing on her background in chemistry, she spent more than ten years studying, researching and building her professional skills along the way.
founder_p2: Based in Phnom Penh, LSV Industry makes laundry soap, fabric softener and dishwashing liquid, as well as facial foam, body wash and shampoo. Working with local chemists, production technicians and farmers, the team turns Cambodian farm produce such as lemongrass, pineapple and mustard greens into everyday products.
founder_p3: Along the way she faced doubts that a Khmer company could build its own industrial products. She answered with careful planning in finance, product quality, marketing, people and technology.
journey_founded_text: LSV Industry was set up in 2013 and grew from a family business into a Khmer factory in Phnom Penh.
journey_brands_text: The company makes its own brands: OKA, best known for laundry soap, along with Empress, Nature Plus and Rins.
journey_quality_text: Production follows Japanese manufacturing standards, and the products are reported to be recognised under ISO, GMP and Halal.
journey_farmers_text: In 2024, when mustard green prices fell, she developed a face mask, facial wash and soaps from them to give farmers another market.
journey_protect_text: She has spoken out against counterfeit copies of Empress products and for fairer access to finance for Cambodian small businesses.
journey_award_text: In 2017 she was named one of the 10 Outstanding Cambodian Women Entrepreneurs.
journey_brands_more: Based in Phnom Penh, LSV Industry makes laundry soap, fabric softener and dishwashing liquid, as well as facial foam, body wash and shampoo.

about_intro: An independent concept for a more thoughtful everyday. Welcome to the world of Empress Cambodia.
story_p1: Empress Cambodia began as a design concept around a question: what if skincare felt less like another task, and more like a moment to come home to yourself?
story_p2: Our answer is a calmer, simpler experience. We take inspiration from botanical textures, natural light, and the small pleasures of a daily routine. This website presents that vision, and invites conversations about what comes next.
